entries.question: अपलाई करने के लिए क्या करना होगा
entries.answer:
Aapko KGMU mein pharmacist ki naukri ke liye apply karne ke liye kuch steps follow karne honge:

1.  **KGMU ki Official Website Visit Karein:** Sabse pehle www.kgmu.org par jaayen.
2.  **"Career" ya "Recruitment" Section Dhundhein:** Website par "Career", "Recruitment", "Vacancies", ya "Jobs" section ko dhoondhein. Yeh section aksar homepage par ya "About Us" ya "Administration" jaise menus ke andar hota hai.
3.  **Pharmacist ki Vacancy Check Karein:** Jab aapko recruitment section mil jaaye, to pharmacist ke pad ke liye koi notification ya advertisement hai ya nahi, yeh dekhein.
4.  **Eligibility Criteria Padhein:** Agar koi vacancy hai, to uske liye yogyata (eligibility criteria) jaise ki shiksha, anubhav, aur anya shartein dhyan se padhein.
5.  **Aavedan Prakriya Samjhein:** Agar aap yogy hain, to aavedan kaise karna hai, yeh samjhein. Kuch naukriyon ke liye online aavedan karna hota hai, jabki kuch mein offline aavedan (jaise ki prescribed format mein form bharkar aur documents ke saath submit karna) karna pad sakta hai.
6.  **Aavedan Karein:** Nirdharit prakriya ke anusar apna aavedan samay seema ke andar karen.

Agar aapko website par pharmacist ki naukri ke baare mein koi current update nahi milta hai, to aap KGMU ke "Career" section ko samay-samay par check karte rahein ya unke recruitment notifications ke liye alert rehne ka koi tarika dhundhein.
entries.ai_question_translated_en: अपलाई करने के लिए क्या करना होगा

entries.question: कितनी जॉब है फीस क्या लगेगी
entries.answer:
KGMU mein pharmacist ki kitni naukriyan khali hain aur uske liye aavedan ki fees kya hogi, yeh jaankari sabhi vacancies ke liye alag-alag ho sakti hai.

Iske liye aapko yeh karna hoga:

1.  **KGMU ki Official Website Check Karein:** www.kgmu.org par jaayein aur "Career" ya "Recruitment" section dekhein.
2.  **Vacancies ki Sankhya:** Jab aapko pharmacist ki naukri ke liye koi advertisement mile, to usmein kitni jagah khali hain, yeh likha hoga.
3.  **Fees ki Jaankari:** Advertisement mein hi aavedan karne ke liye fees (application fee) ke baare mein bhi bataya gaya hoga. Ye fees alag-alag categories ke liye alag ho sakti hai (jaise ki general, OBC, SC/ST ke liye).

Kripya website check karein kyunki yeh jaankari dynamic hoti hai aur naye notifications ke saath badal sakti hai.

entries.question: Mai DMLT me admission lena chahta hu
entries.answer:
KGMU mein DMLT (Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology) mein admission ke liye, aapko paramedical courses ke admission process ke baare mein pata karna hoga.

Yahan kuch mahatvapurna jaankari aur links hain jo aapke liye madadgar ho sakti hain:

*   **Paramedical Admission Information:** Aapko KGMU ki website par "Admissions" section mein "Paramedical Admission Information" ya "Paramedical Courses" se judi jaankari mil sakti hai. Yahan par aapko admission ki dates, eligibility criteria, aur zaroori documents ke baare mein pata chalega.
    *   **Paramedical Admission Instructions and checklist:** [https://kgmu.org/upload_file/marquee/ParamedicalAdmissionInstructionsBatch2024-25/(1/).pdf](https://kgmu.org/upload_file/marquee/ParamedicalAdmissionInstructionsBatch2024-25/(1/).pdf)
    *   **Paramedical Admission Information:** [https://kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php](https://kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php)

*   **Fee Structure:** Admission ke liye fee structure ke baare mein bhi website par jaankari uplabdh hogi.
    *   **Fee Structure:** [https://kgmu.org/paramedical_fee_structure.php](https://kgmu.org/paramedical_fee_structure.php)

*   **Contact Information:** Agar aapko koi aur prashn ho, to aap Admissions office ya Admissions department se sampark kar sakte hain. KGMU ki website par "Contact Us" section mein bhi contact details mil sakti hain.

Kripya DMLT course ke liye sabse latest admission notification aur process ke liye KGMU ki official website (www.kgmu.org) ko regular check karte rahein.
